boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on off-campus Northampton corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Pulaski Park
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 240 Main St.
cards.notes: Use the Main Street park’s benches, chairs, tables, playground, or performance space for a short outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A city park with several documented public-use features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Pulaski Park at 240 Main Street with benches, chairs, tables, a playground, and performance space.
cards.access_notes: Located in downtown Northampton; check city programming separately.

cards.title: Academy of Music Theatre
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 274 Main St.
cards.notes: Check the theatre’s program, then use its Main Street entrance beside Pulaski Park when a performance fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: A downtown performance venue at the Main and New South Street corner.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy of Music Theatre is at 274 Main Street, at the corner of Main and New South streets.
cards.source_title: Map and Directions | Academy of Music
cards.access_notes: The theatre directs visitors to its box office for ticket reservations; performance availability varies.

cards.title: Thornes Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 150 Main St.
cards.notes: Walk through the marketplace’s levels and use its directory to choose a shop, restaurant, or experience before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown marketplace with shops, eateries, and experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: Thornes identifies itself as a historic downtown marketplace at 150 Main Street with more than 25 local shops, eateries, and experiences.
cards.access_notes: Regular marketplace hours and individual tenant hours differ; check the directory before going.

cards.title: R. Michelson Galleries
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 132 Main St.
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the posted hours and spend time with the fine-art and illustration work on view.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street gallery presenting fine art and children’s-book illustration.
cards.evidence_claim: R. Michelson Galleries lists its fine-art gallery at 132 Main Street and identifies fine art and illustration among its offerings.
cards.access_notes: Posted gallery hours vary by day; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Forbes Library
cards.subtitle: West Street corridor — 20 West St.
cards.notes: Use the public library’s collections or local-history resources, and reserve archival research in advance if that is your goal.
cards.short_summary: Northampton’s public library, with local-history and special-collections resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Forbes Library is located at 20 West Street and lists local history, special collections, and the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Library and Museum among its resources.
cards.access_notes: Library hours are posted separately; archival research appointments are recommended.

cards.title: Historic Northampton
cards.subtitle: Bridge Street corridor — 46 Bridge St.
cards.notes: Visit the Main Gallery on Bridge Street to engage with an exhibition, then allow time to look at the historic campus grounds.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum and gallery on the Route 9 approach to downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Northampton’s Main Gallery is at 46 Bridge Street, and its current exhibition is listed with admission by donation.
cards.access_notes: The site lists gallery hours Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: 33 Hawley
cards.subtitle: Hawley Street corridor — 33 Hawley St.
cards.notes: Review the resident organizations’ calendars and visit this accessible arts building for a class, workshop, rehearsal, or performance.
cards.short_summary: A shared community-arts building stewarded by three local arts organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: 33 Hawley at 33 Hawley Street is stewarded by Northampton Center for the Arts, A.P.E., and Northampton Open Media, each with programming there.
cards.source_title: 33 Hawley — Northampton Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: The building lists Wednesday–Saturday open hours; individual events and rentals have separate arrangements.

cards.title: Northampton Community Music Center
cards.subtitle: South Street corridor — 139 South St.
cards.notes: Look for a public performance or activity at the music center, whose programs combine education, performances, and community access.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit community music organization on South Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Northampton Community Music Center is a nonprofit at 139 South Street whose mission includes music education, performances, and accessible activities.
cards.access_notes: Check the center’s current calendar or contact it for program-specific attendance details.

cards.title: Northampton Station
cards.subtitle: Pleasant Street corridor — 170 Pleasant St.
cards.notes: Use the station as a Pleasant Street transit landmark and confirm your train’s schedule, platform guidance, and ticket requirements beforehand.
cards.short_summary: An Amtrak station within walking distance of Main Street and Smith College.
cards.evidence_claim: Amtrak’s Great American Stations page lists Northampton station at 170 Pleasant Street and notes walking access to Main Street and Smith College.
cards.access_notes: Consult Amtrak for current schedules, service notices, and boarding information.

cards.title: Frank Newhall Look Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor — 300 North Main St., Florence
cards.notes: Use the North Main Street park as a destination for its listed outdoor facilities, and check the park’s rules before planning an activity.
cards.short_summary: A Florence park with courts, picnic areas, a theater, and other named facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Newhall Look Memorial Park lists its address as 300 North Main Street and identifies facilities including tennis courts, picnic sites, Pines Theater, and a gazebo.
cards.source_title: Frank Newhall Look Memorial Park: Facilities
cards.access_notes: Confirm park access, facility availability, and any activity-specific requirements with the park.
